depth-054-001.prompt_zh: 上次开会的笔记我已经整理好了，发到你邮箱了。
depth-054-001.reference_answer: I've sorted out the notes from last time's meeting and sent them to your email.
grammar_point: Present perfect for recently completed action

hint_json.simple: 在说一件事做完了，另一件也同步完成了——都和现在有关。
hint_json.intermediate: 两个动作都发生在最近，用现在完成时串联，and 连接。
hint_json.complete: I've _____ the notes from last time's meeting and _____ them to your email.

depth-054-001.learning_goal: Use present perfect to describe a recently completed task with current relevance.
depth-054-001.learning_rationale: Present perfect signals that a completed action has bearing on the present moment.

depth-054-002.prompt_zh: 这栋楼的电梯昨天就坏了，到现在也没人来修。
depth-054-002.reference_answer: The lift in this building broke yesterday, and no one has come to fix it yet.
grammar_point: Past simple for specific past time

hint_json.simple: 一件事昨天发生了，但到现在还没有人来处理。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用过去时 + 昨天这个具体时间。后半句用现在完成时 + yet 表达「到现在还没」。
hint_json.complete: The lift in this building _____ yesterday, and no one has come to fix it _____.

depth-054-002.learning_goal: Use past simple for a specific past event and present perfect with 'yet' for an unresolved situation.
depth-054-002.learning_rationale: Combining past simple (specific time) and present perfect (up to now) is a core narrative pattern.

depth-054-003.prompt_zh: 申请流程比我想的要简单，只需要填一张表就行了。
depth-054-003.reference_answer: The application process was simpler than I expected — all I had to do was fill in a form.
grammar_point: All + pronoun + had to do was + base form

hint_json.simple: 在说实际体验比预期简单——只需做一件事。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 比较级 + than I expected 表达「比我想的……」。后半句用 all I had to do was 强调简单。
hint_json.complete: The application process was _____ than I expected — all I had to do was _____ a form.

depth-054-003.learning_goal: Compare expected vs actual difficulty using comparative structures and emphasize simplicity.
depth-054-003.learning_rationale: 'Simpler than I expected' and 'all I had to do was' are everyday patterns for expressing pleasant surprises.

depth-054-004.prompt_zh: 我以为要排很久的队，结果只等了五分钟就轮到了。
depth-054-004.reference_answer: I thought I'd have to queue for ages, but I only waited five minutes before it was my turn.

hint_json.simple: 预期会很久，实际却很快。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 thought I'd have to 表达过去的预期。后半句用 only + 时间 + before 表达实际很快。
hint_json.complete: I thought I'd have to _____ for ages, but I only waited five minutes before it was _____.

depth-054-004.learning_goal: Express a contrast between expectation and reality using 'thought I'd' and 'only + time'.
depth-054-004.learning_rationale: Contrasting expectations with outcomes is one of the most common narrative patterns in everyday English.

depth-054-005.prompt_zh: 你说话的语气听起来不太高兴，是不是我刚才说错什么了？
depth-054-005.reference_answer: You sound a bit upset — did I say something wrong just now?

hint_json.simple: 注意到对方的情绪变化，问是不是自己造成的。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 sound + 形容词表达「听起来……」。后半句用 did I + 动词原形问是不是自己做了什么。
hint_json.complete: You _____ a bit upset — did I _____ something wrong just now?

depth-054-005.learning_goal: Use sensory verbs with adjectives to describe impressions and ask for clarification.
depth-054-005.learning_rationale: 'Sound/look/feel + adjective' is the natural pattern for describing perceived emotional states.

depth-054-006.prompt_zh: 他跑得很快，但最后一百米明显慢了。
depth-054-006.reference_answer: He ran very fast, but he slowed down noticeably in the last hundred metres.

hint_json.simple: 前半句说跑得快，后半句说后来变慢了——两个方式词。
hint_json.intermediate: fast 本身就是副词不加 ly。noticeable 加 ly 变副词修饰 slowed down。
hint_json.complete: He ran very _____, but he slowed down _____ in the last hundred metres.

depth-054-006.learning_goal: Distinguish adverb forms and place them correctly after verbs.
depth-054-006.learning_rationale: Some adverbs have the same form as adjectives (fast, hard, late), while others add -ly — a common confusion point.

depth-054-007.prompt_zh: 我已经帮您约好了下周二下午三点的牙医，到时候提前十分钟到就行。
depth-054-007.reference_answer: I've already booked you in for next Tuesday at three in the afternoon — just arrive ten minutes early.

hint_json.simple: 已经帮对方预约好了，告诉对方时间和到诊要求。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用现在完成时 + already 表达已完成的预约。后半句用 just + 祈使句。
hint_json.complete: I've already _____ you in for next Tuesday at three — just _____ ten minutes early.

depth-054-007.learning_goal: Use present perfect to confirm a completed booking and give arrival instructions.
depth-054-007.learning_rationale: 'I've booked you in for' is the idiomatic phrase for confirming appointments on someone's behalf.

depth-054-008.prompt_zh: 我想约一下理发店的王师傅，他这周六上午有空吗？
depth-054-008.reference_answer: I'd like to book an appointment with Mr Wang at the barber's — is he free this Saturday morning?
grammar_point: Would like to for polite request

hint_json.simple: 在问一个理发师的时间安排——想约、问空不空。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 I'd like to + 动词原形表达想预约。后半句用 be free + 时间段问是否有空。
hint_json.complete: I'd like to _____ an appointment with Mr Wang at the barber's — is he _____ this Saturday morning?

depth-054-008.learning_goal: Make a polite appointment request and check availability using 'I'd like to' and 'be free'.
depth-054-008.learning_rationale: 'I'd like to book' and 'Is he free...' are the standard polite formulas for making service appointments.

depth-054-009.prompt_zh: 从我家到公司坐地铁大约要四十分钟，包括换乘的时间。
depth-054-009.reference_answer: It takes about forty minutes to get from my place to the office by subway, including the transfer.

hint_json.simple: 在说通勤时间，还补充了换乘。
hint_json.intermediate: 用 it takes + 时间 + to + 动词原形表达「需要多少时间做某事」。用 including 补充时间构成。
hint_json.complete: It _____ about forty minutes to get from my place to the office by subway, _____ the transfer.

depth-054-009.learning_goal: Express commute duration using 'it takes' and add details with 'including'.
depth-054-009.learning_rationale: 'It takes + time' is the universal template for describing how long journeys take in English.

depth-054-010.prompt_zh: 走到最近的药店大概要十分钟，不过路上有家便利店可以先看看。
depth-054-010.reference_answer: It'll take about ten minutes to walk to the nearest pharmacy, though there's a convenience store on the way you could check first.

hint_json.simple: 在说走到药店的时间，并提供了一个途中替代方案。
hint_json.intermediate: 主句用 it'll take + 时间。用 though 引入一个让步的替代方案，could 做建议。
hint_json.complete: It'll _____ about ten minutes to walk to the nearest pharmacy, though there's a convenience store you _____ check first.

depth-054-010.learning_goal: Express journey duration with a concessive alternative suggestion.
depth-054-010.learning_rationale: Real-world navigation advice often pairs duration estimates with 'though' for flexible alternatives.

depth-054-011.prompt_zh: 请问这部电影适合十二岁的孩子看吗？有没有什么不太合适的镜头？
depth-054-011.reference_answer: Is this film suitable for a twelve-year-old? Are there any scenes that might not be appropriate?
grammar_point: Indefinite article with zero article choice

hint_json.simple: 在问电影是否适合某个年龄段，担心有不合适的内容。
hint_json.intermediate: 第一句用 be suitable for + 年龄段。第二句用 Are there any 提问存在。
hint_json.complete: Is this film suitable for _____ twelve-year-old? Are there any scenes that might not be _____?

depth-054-011.learning_goal: Choose between a/an and zero article when describing general categories of people.
depth-054-011.learning_rationale: The choice between 'a twelve-year-old' and 'twelve-year-olds' signals whether you mean a specific child or children in general.

depth-054-012.prompt_zh: 手机放口袋里不小心拨出去了，不好意思打扰了。
depth-054-012.reference_answer: My phone dialled by accident in my pocket — sorry to bother you.
grammar_point: Sorry to + base form for apology

hint_json.simple: 在解释是一个意外电话，道歉。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 by accident 表达非故意的行为。后半句用 sorry to + 动词原形道歉。
hint_json.complete: My phone dialled by _____ in my pocket — sorry to _____ you.

depth-054-012.learning_goal: Use 'by accident' correctly and apologise with 'sorry to + verb'.
depth-054-012.learning_rationale: 'By accident' is a fixed phrase with no article — a common collocation learners need to memorise.

depth-054-013.prompt_zh: 音乐会已经开始了，我们恐怕进不去了。
depth-054-013.reference_answer: The concert has already started — I'm afraid we won't be able to get in.
grammar_point: Won't be able to for future inability

hint_json.simple: 已经在说一个无法改变的事实——太晚了进不去了。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用现在完成时 + already。后半句用 I'm afraid 引出坏消息，won't be able to 表达无法进。
hint_json.complete: The concert has already _____ — I'm afraid we won't be able to _____ in.

depth-054-013.learning_goal: Express that an event has started and acknowledge the consequence of missing entry.
depth-054-013.learning_rationale: 'I'm afraid + consequence' softens bad news, and 'has already started' establishes the irreversible fact.

depth-054-014.prompt_zh: 还有半小时才开场，我们先找个地方坐坐吧。
depth-054-014.reference_answer: There's still half an hour before it starts — let's find somewhere to sit.

hint_json.simple: 时间还早，建议先休息。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 there's + 时间 + before 表达还剩多少时间。后半句用 let's 做建议。
hint_json.complete: There's still half an hour _____ it starts — let's _____ somewhere to sit.

depth-054-014.learning_goal: State remaining time before an event and make a suggestion for the wait.
depth-054-014.learning_rationale: 'There's still + time + before' is the natural way to express how much waiting time remains.

depth-054-015.prompt_zh: 我昨天请假去办签证，结果大使馆系统坏了，白跑一趟。
depth-054-015.reference_answer: I took the day off yesterday to get my visa sorted, but the embassy's system was down — a wasted trip.

hint_json.simple: 请假去办事，结果系统坏了没办成。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 took the day off to + 动词原形。中间用 but 引出意外结果。最后用名词短语总结。
hint_json.complete: I took the day off yesterday to _____ my visa sorted, but the embassy's system was _____ — a wasted trip.

depth-054-015.learning_goal: Narrate taking time off for a purpose and an unexpected outcome.
depth-054-015.learning_rationale: 'Took the day off to + V' is the standard pattern for explaining work absences with a purpose.

depth-054-016.prompt_zh: 家里水管漏水，我明天得请半天假等工人来修。
depth-054-016.reference_answer: There's a leak in the pipe at home — I'll need to take half a day off tomorrow to wait for the plumber.

hint_json.simple: 家里有故障，需要请假在家等维修。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 there's 引出问题。后半句用 need to take + 时间 + off 请假。
hint_json.complete: There's a leak in the pipe at home — I'll need to _____ half a day off tomorrow to wait for the _____.

depth-054-016.learning_goal: Explain a home emergency and state the need for time off.
depth-054-016.learning_rationale: 'Need to take time off to + V' clearly links the leave request to a practical reason.

depth-054-017.prompt_zh: 这本语法书确实讲得很清楚，我推荐给好几个同事了。
depth-054-017.reference_answer: This grammar book really does explain things clearly — I've recommended it to several colleagues.

hint_json.simple: 在强调一本书确实好，已经推荐给多人。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 does + 动词原形强调「确实」。后半句用现在完成时表示推荐过多次。
hint_json.complete: This grammar book really _____ explain things clearly — I've recommended it to several _____.

depth-054-017.learning_goal: Use emphatic 'does' to add conviction and present perfect for repeated past actions.
depth-054-017.learning_rationale: Emphatic auxiliary ('does explain') is a powerful tool for sincere recommendations in English.

depth-054-018.prompt_zh: 照理说他应该已经到了，会不会是走错路了？
depth-054-018.reference_answer: He should have arrived by now — do you think he might have taken a wrong turn?
grammar_point: Should have + past participle for expectation

hint_json.simple: 在推测为什么人还没到——按理该到了，可能出错了。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 should have + 过去分词表达「按理已经……」。后半句用 might have + 过去分词猜测。
hint_json.complete: He should have _____ by now — do you think he might have _____ a wrong turn?

depth-054-018.learning_goal: Use 'should have' for unfulfilled expectations and 'might have' for past speculation.
depth-054-018.learning_rationale: Speculating about past events requires precise auxiliary choice between obligation (should) and possibility (might).

depth-054-019.prompt_zh: 虽然是临时通知，但我相信团队能应付得来。
depth-054-019.reference_answer: Even though it's short notice, I believe the team can handle it.

hint_json.simple: 承认情况不理想，但表达对能力的信任。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 Even though 引导让步。后半句用 I believe + 从句表示信任。
hint_json.complete: _____ it's short notice, I believe the team can _____ it.

depth-054-019.learning_goal: Acknowledge a difficult situation while expressing confidence in the team.
depth-054-019.learning_rationale: Leadership language uses concessive structures to acknowledge reality without undermining confidence.

depth-054-020.prompt_zh: 不是你的错，服务器昨天就出问题了，跟你的修改没关系。
depth-054-020.reference_answer: It's not your fault — the server's been having problems since yesterday, and your changes had nothing to do with it.
grammar_point: It's not your fault for reassurance
Present perfect continuous for ongoing issue

hint_json.simple: 在安慰对方不是他的责任，解释真正的原因。
hint_json.intermediate: 开头用 It's not your fault 澄清。中间用现在完成进行时说明问题持续。最后用 had nothing to do with 撇清关系。
hint_json.complete: It's not your _____ — the server's been having problems since yesterday, and your changes had nothing to _____ with it.

depth-054-020.learning_goal: Reassure someone they are not at fault and explain the real cause.
depth-054-020.learning_rationale: 'It's not your fault' and 'had nothing to do with' are essential for defusing workplace tension.

depth-054-021.prompt_zh: 公司要求所有新员工在入职前必须完成安全培训。
depth-054-021.reference_answer: The company requires that all new employees complete safety training before starting.

hint_json.simple: 在说一条公司规定——入职前必须培训。
hint_json.intermediate: 主句用 require that + 主语 + 动词原形（虚拟语气）。用 before + V-ing 表达时间。
hint_json.complete: The company requires that all new employees _____ safety training before _____.

depth-054-021.learning_goal: Use the subjunctive base verb form after 'require that' in formal policy statements.
depth-054-021.learning_rationale: Formal English uses the subjunctive (base verb after 'require/suggest/insist that') — a hallmark of professional writing.

depth-054-022.prompt_zh: 我建议你把这份报告在提交之前再找人校对一遍。
depth-054-022.reference_answer: I suggest that you have someone proofread this report once more before submitting it.

hint_json.simple: 在建议找别人再检查一遍。
hint_json.intermediate: 用 suggest that + 主语 + 动词原形。用 have someone + 动词原形表达「找人做」。
hint_json.complete: I suggest that you have someone _____ this report once more before _____ it.

depth-054-022.learning_goal: Combine subjunctive mood with causative structure in a professional recommendation.
depth-054-022.learning_rationale: Subjunctive + causative ('suggest that you have someone + V') is a compact pattern for formal work advice.

depth-054-023.prompt_zh: 这道工序要求工人必须戴护目镜。
depth-054-023.reference_answer: This procedure requires that workers must wear safety goggles.

hint_json.simple: 一条安全规定——必须戴防护。
hint_json.intermediate: 主句用 require that + 主语 + 动词原形。must 和动词原形一起用更正式。
hint_json.complete: This procedure requires that workers _____ safety goggles.

depth-054-023.learning_goal: Use 'require that' with base verb for mandatory workplace safety rules.
depth-054-023.learning_rationale: Safety instructions use 'require that + base verb' for unambiguous mandatory language.

depth-054-024.prompt_zh: 实验室里不能吃东西，但可以在休息室喝咖啡。
depth-054-024.reference_answer: You're not allowed to eat in the lab, but you can have coffee in the break room.
grammar_point: Be not allowed to for prohibition

hint_json.simple: 说哪里不能做什么、哪里可以做什么。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 be not allowed to 表达禁止。后半句用 can 给予许可。
hint_json.complete: You're not _____ to eat in the lab, but you can _____ coffee in the break room.

depth-054-024.learning_goal: Distinguish prohibition (not allowed to) from permission (can) in workplace rules.
depth-054-024.learning_rationale: 'Not allowed to' signals a rule, while 'can' signals a permission — different authority levels.

depth-054-025.prompt_zh: 我已经打电话确认了酒店预订，他们说房间会保留到晚上十点。
depth-054-025.reference_answer: I've called to confirm the hotel booking — they said the room would be held until ten at night.
grammar_point: Present perfect for recently completed call

hint_json.simple: 已经电话确认了预订，转述酒店的政策。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用现在完成时。后半句转述用 they said + would be + 过去分词。
hint_json.complete: I've called to _____ the hotel booking — they said the room would be _____ until ten.

depth-054-025.learning_goal: Confirm a booking by phone and relay hotel policy using reported speech.
depth-054-025.learning_rationale: Hotel confirmation calls require present perfect for the completed call and reported speech for policy relay.

depth-054-026.prompt_zh: 麻烦帮我查一下，我用这个名字订的标间还有吗？
depth-054-026.reference_answer: Could you check if the standard room I booked under this name is still available?

hint_json.simple: 在请前台查自己的预订还存不存在。
hint_json.intermediate: 用 Could you check if 开头做请求。book under + 名字 表达「用什么名字订的」。
hint_json.complete: Could you check if the standard room I booked _____ this name is still _____?

depth-054-026.learning_goal: Make a polite hotel inquiry with embedded questions and 'book under + name'.
depth-054-026.learning_rationale: 'Book under + name' is the standard phrase for identifying reservations — not 'book with' or 'book by'.

depth-054-027.prompt_zh: 我们想订一间可以看到海景的双人房，最好是高楼层。
depth-054-027.reference_answer: We'd like to book a double room with a sea view, preferably on a high floor.

hint_json.simple: 在提订房要求——房型、景色、楼层偏好。
hint_json.intermediate: 用 We'd like to book 表达想订。用 with + 名词描述特征。用 preferably 软性表达偏好。
hint_json.complete: We'd like to _____ a double room with a sea view, preferably on a _____ floor.

depth-054-027.learning_goal: Make a hotel room request with feature descriptions and soft preferences.
depth-054-027.learning_rationale: 'Preferably' adds a preference without making it a deal-breaker — key for polite booking language.

depth-054-028.prompt_zh: 我看你们的网站上显示这周末还有空房，能帮我预留一间吗？
depth-054-028.reference_answer: I saw on your website that you still have vacancies this weekend — could you hold a room for me?

hint_json.simple: 已经看过网站说有房，现在请预留。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 I saw + that 从句转述网上看到的信息。后半句用 could you + 动词原形请求预留。
hint_json.complete: I saw on your website that you still have _____ this weekend — could you _____ a room for me?

depth-054-028.learning_goal: Reference online information and make a reservation request using 'I saw that' + 'could you'.
depth-054-028.learning_rationale: 'I saw on your website that' frames the request with prior knowledge — polite and efficient.

depth-054-029.prompt_zh: 从这儿坐大巴到机场大概多久？我怕赶不上飞机。
depth-054-029.reference_answer: How long does it take to get to the airport by bus from here? I'm worried I might miss my flight.
grammar_point: How long does it take to + verb

hint_json.simple: 在问路程时间并表达担心。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 How long does it take to + 动词原形问时间。后半句用 I'm worried + might 表达担忧。
hint_json.complete: How long does it take to get to the airport by bus _____ here? I'm worried I might _____ my flight.

depth-054-029.learning_goal: Ask about journey duration and express a time-related worry.
depth-054-029.learning_rationale: 'I'm worried I might + V' is the natural collocation for expressing travel anxiety.

depth-054-030.prompt_zh: 售票处在大厅右边，你看到一个蓝色指示牌就到了。
depth-054-030.reference_answer: The ticket office is on the right side of the hall — you'll see a blue sign and then you're there.

hint_json.simple: 在说售票处在哪儿——看到什么标志就到了。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 be + 介词短语说位置。后半句用 see + 标志 + and then 表达。
hint_json.complete: The ticket office is on the right side of the _____ — you'll see a blue sign and then you're _____.

depth-054-030.learning_goal: Give a location description with a visual landmark for confirmation.
depth-054-030.learning_rationale: Landmark-based directions ('see X and you're there') are easier to follow than compass directions.

depth-054-031.prompt_zh: 我打电话是想问一下，你们那款蓝色沙发还有现货吗？
depth-054-031.reference_answer: I'm calling to check whether you still have that blue sofa in stock.

hint_json.simple: 打电话咨询商品的库存情况。
hint_json.intermediate: 用 I'm calling to + 动词原形说明目的。用 whether 引导间接问句，in stock 表达「有现货」。
hint_json.complete: I'm calling to _____ whether you still have that blue sofa in _____.

depth-054-031.learning_goal: Use 'I'm calling to' and embedded questions for telephone stock inquiries.
depth-054-031.learning_rationale: 'I'm calling to + V' is the standard telephone opener; 'in stock' is the correct inventory term.

depth-054-032.prompt_zh: 我刚才打电话问了，那家餐厅不接受当天预订，得提前两天。
depth-054-032.reference_answer: I just called and checked — that restaurant doesn't take same-day bookings; you need to book two days ahead.
grammar_point: Need to + base form for requirement

hint_json.simple: 已电话确认过，餐厅有预订规则。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句转述电话结果用 doesn't + 动词原形。后半句用 need to + 动词原形说要求。
hint_json.complete: I just called and checked — that restaurant doesn't _____ same-day bookings; you need to _____ two days ahead.

depth-054-032.learning_goal: Relay booking information obtained by phone using reported facts and requirements.
depth-054-032.learning_rationale: 'Doesn't take + bookings' and 'need to book + ahead' are the natural collocations for reservation rules.

depth-054-033.prompt_zh: 这两款手机价钱差不多，但拍照效果差很多。
depth-054-033.reference_answer: These two phones cost about the same, but the camera quality differs a lot.
grammar_point: Differ + a lot for big difference

hint_json.simple: 两款产品价格接近但一个功能差距大。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 about the same 表达差不多。后半句用 differ + a lot 表达差别大。
hint_json.complete: These two phones _____ about the same, but the camera quality _____ a lot.

depth-054-033.learning_goal: Compare products using 'about the same' and 'differ a lot' for nuanced comparison.
depth-054-033.learning_rationale: 'About the same' and 'differ a lot' are more natural than formal comparative structures in casual shopping talk.

depth-054-034.prompt_zh: 今天的天气比昨天暖和多了，可以少穿一件。
depth-054-034.reference_answer: It's much warmer today than yesterday — you can wear one less layer.

hint_json.simple: 天气比昨天暖和很多，穿衣建议。
hint_json.intermediate: 用 much + 比较级 + than 表达「……得多」。后半句用 can + 动词原形给建议。
hint_json.complete: It's much _____ today than yesterday — you can _____ one less layer.

depth-054-034.learning_goal: Use 'much + comparative' to express a significant difference in degree.
depth-054-034.learning_rationale: 'Much warmer' is far more natural than 'more warm' — a core comparative pattern learners must internalise.

depth-054-035.prompt_zh: 这件事越早处理越好，不然小问题会变成大麻烦。
depth-054-035.reference_answer: The sooner this is dealt with, the better — or a small issue could turn into a big problem.
grammar_point: Could turn into for potential outcome

hint_json.simple: 越早越好——不然小变大。
hint_json.intermediate: 用 the sooner..., the better... 结构。后半句用 could turn into 表达可能的结果。
hint_json.complete: The _____ this is dealt with, the _____ — or a small issue could turn into a big problem.

depth-054-035.learning_goal: Use 'the sooner..., the better' double comparative pattern to express urgency.
depth-054-035.learning_rationale: Double comparatives ('the more...the more') are a compact way to express proportional relationships.

depth-054-036.prompt_zh: 他吃得比我多，但怎么也吃不胖。
depth-054-036.reference_answer: He eats more than I do, but he never seems to put on weight.

hint_json.simple: 在说一个人吃得多但不胖。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 more than + 代词 + do 比较。后半句用 never seems to 表达「怎么也不」。
hint_json.complete: He eats more than I _____, but he never seems to _____ on weight.

depth-054-036.learning_goal: Use 'than + pronoun + auxiliary' for comparison and 'never seems to' for counter-expectation.
depth-054-036.learning_rationale: The 'than + pronoun + do' pattern prevents the common error of 'more than me' in formal contexts.

depth-054-037.prompt_zh: 做完这页练习就可以休息了，你已经连续学了快两个小时了。
depth-054-037.reference_answer: You can take a break after finishing this page — you've been studying for almost two hours straight.

hint_json.simple: 说做完当前任务就能休息了，并说明已经努力了多久。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 after + V-ing 表达时间条件。后半句用现在完成进行时 + for 时间段。
hint_json.complete: You can take a break after _____ this page — you've been studying for _____ two hours straight.

depth-054-037.learning_goal: Use 'after + gerund' for sequencing and present perfect continuous for ongoing duration.
depth-054-037.learning_rationale: 'After + V-ing' is the most natural way to express 'when you finish X' in English.

depth-054-038.prompt_zh: 我把这堆邮件回完了就去吃午饭，你先去吧。
depth-054-038.reference_answer: I'll go for lunch after I've replied to this pile of emails — you go ahead.
grammar_point: Future time clause with present perfect
Go ahead for permission to precede

hint_json.simple: 在说做完任务后的计划，让对方先去。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 I'll + 动词原形 + after + 现在完成时表达「做完后就去」。后半句用 go ahead。
hint_json.complete: I'll go for lunch after I've _____ to this pile of emails — you go _____.

depth-054-038.learning_goal: Use 'after + present perfect' in a future time clause and 'go ahead' to release someone.
depth-054-038.learning_rationale: English uses present perfect (not future) after time conjunctions like 'after' — a rule many languages don't share.

depth-054-039.prompt_zh: 如果你能提前一天把资料发给我，我可以帮你过一遍。
depth-054-039.reference_answer: If you can send me the materials a day in advance, I can go over them for you.
grammar_point: Main clause with can for offer

hint_json.simple: 有条件地提供帮助——提前发资料就帮看。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 if + can 表达条件。后半句用 can + 动词短语表达「可以帮……」。
hint_json.complete: If you can send me the materials a day _____, I can go _____ them for you.

depth-054-039.learning_goal: Use a conditional with 'can' on both sides to offer conditional help.
depth-054-039.learning_rationale: Dual 'can' conditionals (ability → offer) elegantly express help conditional on someone else's action.

depth-054-040.prompt_zh: 要是你早一天跟我说，我就能帮你改签机票了。
depth-054-040.reference_answer: If you had told me a day earlier, I could have helped you change the flight.
grammar_point: Could have + past participle for lost opportunity

hint_json.simple: 在说一个已经错过的机会——早知道就能帮忙了。
hint_json.intermediate: 用 if + had + 过去分词 (过去完成时) + could have + 过去分词表达本来可以。
hint_json.complete: If you had _____ me a day earlier, I could have _____ you change the flight.

depth-054-040.learning_goal: Use third conditional to express a missed opportunity due to timing.
depth-054-040.learning_rationale: Third conditional captures regret and hindsight — one of the most emotionally expressive English structures.

depth-054-041.prompt_zh: 等你到了机场再给我打电话，我手机一直开着。
depth-054-041.reference_answer: Call me when you get to the airport — I'll keep my phone on.

hint_json.simple: 让对方到了再联系——说了自己这边会保持联系畅通。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 祈使句 + when 从句（现在时）。后半句用 I'll keep + 状态。
hint_json.complete: Call me when you _____ to the airport — I'll keep my phone _____.

depth-054-041.learning_goal: Use 'when + present simple' in a future-oriented command.
depth-054-041.learning_rationale: English uses present simple (not future) in 'when' clauses referring to the future.

depth-054-042.prompt_zh: 上次我等你的时候顺便把下周的行程安排好了。
depth-054-042.reference_answer: Last time I waited for you, I went ahead and sorted out next week's itinerary.

hint_json.simple: 在说上次等人的时候顺便做了什么。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 when 从句 + 过去时描述过去场景。后半句用 went ahead and 表示主动做。
hint_json.complete: Last time I waited for _____, I went ahead and _____ out next week's itinerary.

depth-054-042.learning_goal: Narrate a past sequence using 'when + past' and 'went ahead and + past'.
depth-054-042.learning_rationale: 'Went ahead and + V' signals proactive initiative during a wait — a natural conversational expression.

depth-054-043.prompt_zh: 如果你感兴趣的话，我把活动详情发给你。
depth-054-043.reference_answer: If you're interested, I'll send you the event details.

hint_json.simple: 在说如果有兴趣就发详细信息。
hint_json.intermediate: 用 if + 一般现在时（条件），主句用 I'll + 动词原形（结果）。
hint_json.complete: If you're _____, I'll _____ you the event details.

depth-054-043.learning_goal: Use first conditional with present simple in the if-clause for real future possibilities.
depth-054-043.learning_rationale: The if-clause in first conditionals uses present tense even though it refers to the future.

depth-054-044.prompt_zh: 只要有两个人报名，这个课程就会照常开。
depth-054-044.reference_answer: As long as two people sign up, the course will run as usual.
grammar_point: As long as for minimum condition

hint_json.simple: 在说最少需要多少人才能开课。
hint_json.intermediate: 用 as long as + 主语 + 动词原形表达条件。主句用 will + 动词原形说结果。
hint_json.complete: As long as two people _____ up, the course will _____ as usual.

depth-054-044.learning_goal: Use 'as long as' to express a minimum condition for a guaranteed outcome.
depth-054-044.learning_rationale: 'As long as' is the most common alternative to 'if' for minimum-threshold conditions.

depth-054-045.prompt_zh: 如果你能在下班之前把报表交上来，我就不用周末加班了。
depth-054-045.reference_answer: If you can hand in the report before the end of the day, I won't have to work over the weekend.
grammar_point: Won't have to for avoided obligation

hint_json.simple: 在说一个条件——准时交就不用加班。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 if you can + 动词原形表达条件。后半句用 won't have to 表达「就不用……」。
hint_json.complete: If you can hand in the report _____ the end of the day, I won't have to _____ over the weekend.

depth-054-045.learning_goal: Use a conditional to link someone's action to your own avoided obligation.
depth-054-045.learning_rationale: Linking 'if you can' with 'I won't have to' creates polite workplace leverage without direct demands.

depth-054-046.prompt_zh: 你能不能帮我把这份翻译校对一下？不需要改内容，只看看有没有语法错误就行。
depth-054-046.reference_answer: Could you proofread this translation for me? No need to change the content — just check for grammar errors.

hint_json.simple: 在请人帮忙看看翻译，说清楚只看语法不用改内容。
hint_json.intermediate: 开头用 Could you + 动词原形做请求。用 No need to 表达不用做什么。用 just 限定范围。
hint_json.complete: Could you _____ this translation for me? No need to change the content — just _____ for grammar errors.

depth-054-046.learning_goal: Make a polite request with specific scope limitations using 'no need to' and 'just'.
depth-054-046.learning_rationale: Scoping requests with 'no need to + V' and 'just + V' makes the ask feel smaller and more likely to be accepted.

depth-054-047.prompt_zh: 我在群里说了好几次了，但好像没人在意这个问题。
depth-054-047.reference_answer: I've mentioned it several times in the group chat, but no one seems to care about this issue.

hint_json.simple: 在说已经反复提过某件事但没人关注。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用现在完成时 + several times 表达反复做过。后半句用 no one seems to 表达「好像没人……」。
hint_json.complete: I've mentioned it several times in the group chat, but no one _____ to care about this issue.

depth-054-047.learning_goal: Report repeated communication and perceived unresponsiveness using present perfect and 'seems to'.
depth-054-047.learning_rationale: 'Seems to' softens a complaint from accusation to observation — crucial for workplace diplomacy.

depth-054-048.prompt_zh: 我觉得咱们之间的沟通出问题了，上次的决定根本没传达给我。
depth-054-048.reference_answer: I think there's a breakdown in communication between us — the decision from last time wasn't even passed on to me.

hint_json.simple: 在反映沟通问题——上次的决定没传到。
hint_json.intermediate: 开头用 I think there's 引出问题。后半句用被动 wasn't passed on 强调信息没有传达。even 加强语气。
hint_json.complete: I think there's a breakdown in _____ between us — the decision from last time wasn't even _____ on to me.

depth-054-048.learning_goal: Address a communication gap using nominalised problems and passive voice to stay objective.
depth-054-048.learning_rationale: Nominalising ('a breakdown in communication') depersonalises conflict — a key professional communication skill.

depth-054-049.prompt_zh: 请在三天之内回复这封邮件，否则名额会被取消。
depth-054-049.reference_answer: Please reply to this email within three days, or your spot will be cancelled.

hint_json.simple: 在给一个邮件回复的截止时间，并说明后果。
hint_json.intermediate: 用 Please + 动词原形 + within 时间表达礼貌的截止要求。用 or 引出后果，用被动 will be cancelled 表达取消。
hint_json.complete: Please reply to this email _____ three days, or your spot will be _____.

depth-054-049.learning_goal: Give a deadline with consequences in formal written English.
depth-054-049.learning_rationale: 'Please + V + within + time, or + passive consequence' is a template for formal deadline communications.

depth-054-050.prompt_zh: 收到请回复，如果在周五之前没有确认，我们默认你放弃这次机会。
depth-054-050.reference_answer: Please confirm receipt — if we don't hear back by Friday, we'll assume you've given up this opportunity.

hint_json.simple: 要求确认收到，并说明沉默的默认含义。
hint_json.intermediate: 开头用 Please confirm receipt。后半句用 if + 否定现在时 + by 时间，主句用 will assume。
hint_json.complete: Please _____ receipt — if we don't hear back by _____, we'll assume you've _____ this opportunity.

depth-054-050.learning_goal: Use formal acknowledgment language and a conditional default assumption.
depth-054-050.learning_rationale: 'Confirm receipt' and 'if we don't hear back by...' are stock phrases for formal deadline communications.

depth-054-051.prompt_zh: 搬到这儿已经三年了，但我还是不太习惯这儿的冬天。
depth-054-051.reference_answer: I've been living here for three years now, but I still haven't quite got used to the winters.
grammar_point: Present perfect continuous for duration up to now
Still haven't + PP for ongoing challenge

hint_json.simple: 已经住了三年了，但还是不太适应气候。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用现在完成进行时 + for 表达持续。后半句用 still haven't got used to 表达还不适应。
hint_json.complete: I've been living here for three years _____, but I still haven't quite got _____ to the winters.

depth-054-051.learning_goal: Use present perfect continuous to express ongoing duration and 'still haven't got used to' for persistent difficulty.
depth-054-051.learning_rationale: 'Still haven't got used to' expresses ongoing adjustment struggles better than simple present.

depth-054-052.prompt_zh: 雨从昨天晚上就开始下了，到现在还没停。
depth-054-052.reference_answer: It's been raining since last night, and it still hasn't stopped.

hint_json.simple: 在说一场从昨晚持续到现在的雨。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 has been + V-ing + since 时间点。后半句用 still hasn't + 过去分词表达还没停。
hint_json.complete: It's been raining _____ last night, and it still hasn't _____.

depth-054-052.learning_goal: Use present perfect continuous with 'since' and 'still' for weather duration.
depth-054-052.learning_rationale: Weather-talk is one of the most common contexts for present perfect continuous in everyday English.

depth-054-053.prompt_zh: 我们认识快十年了，但每次见面还是能聊很久。
depth-054-053.reference_answer: We've known each other for almost ten years, but every time we meet we can still talk for ages.

hint_json.simple: 在说一段长期的友谊——认识了很久，交流依然很好。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用现在完成时 + for 时间段表示认识多久。后半句用 every time + 一般现在时。
hint_json.complete: We've known each other for almost ten _____, but every time we meet we can _____ talk for ages.

depth-054-053.learning_goal: Use present perfect with 'for' to describe long-term relationships.
depth-054-053.learning_rationale: 'Have known + for + duration' is the standard template for describing relationship length.

depth-054-054.prompt_zh: 他学钢琴已经学了五年了，今年准备考八级。
depth-054-054.reference_answer: He's been learning the piano for five years now, and he's preparing for the grade eight exam this year.

hint_json.simple: 在说一个人学琴的时长和今年的考试计划。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用现在完成进行时 + for 表达学了多久。后半句用 be + V-ing 表达今年的准备。
hint_json.complete: He's been learning the piano for five years _____, and he's _____ for the grade eight exam this year.

depth-054-054.learning_goal: Use present perfect continuous for learning duration and present continuous for current goals.
depth-054-054.learning_rationale: 'Have been learning + for' and 'is preparing for' smoothly transition from past effort to present goal.

depth-054-055.prompt_zh: 请问可以麻烦您把音乐调小声一点吗？我这边在开会。
depth-054-055.reference_answer: Would you mind turning the music down a bit? I'm in a meeting here.
grammar_point: Would you mind + gerund for polite request

hint_json.simple: 在很礼貌地请别人把音量调低——并说明原因。
hint_json.intermediate: 用 Would you mind + V-ing 做非常礼貌的请求。a bit 软化语气。
hint_json.complete: Would you mind _____ the music down a bit? I'm in a _____ here.

depth-054-055.learning_goal: Make a polite request for volume adjustment using 'Would you mind + gerund'.
depth-054-055.learning_rationale: 'Would you mind + V-ing' is the most polite formula for asking someone to change their behaviour.

depth-054-056.prompt_zh: 麻烦您把空调温度调高一点，这个房间太冷了。
depth-054-056.reference_answer: Could you turn the air conditioning up a little? This room is freezing.
grammar_point: Could you + base form for request

hint_json.simple: 请人调温度——房间太冷。
hint_json.intermediate: 用 Could you + 动词原形做请求。turn up 是「调高」。
hint_json.complete: Could you turn the air conditioning _____ a little? This room is _____.

depth-054-056.learning_goal: Use 'Could you turn up/down' to request temperature adjustment with a reason.
depth-054-056.learning_rationale: 'Turn up/down' are the everyday phrasal verbs for adjusting settings — far more natural than 'increase/decrease'.

depth-054-057.prompt_zh: 一般情况下，这种申请需要三个工作日来处理。
depth-054-057.reference_answer: Generally speaking, this type of application takes three working days to process.

hint_json.simple: 在说处理的常规时间。
hint_json.intermediate: 用 Generally speaking 开头表达一般情况。用 takes + 时间 + to + 动词原形。
hint_json.complete: Generally _____, this type of application takes three working days to _____.

depth-054-057.learning_goal: Use 'generally speaking' to frame a general rule and 'takes + time + to + V' for duration.
depth-054-057.learning_rationale: 'Generally speaking' is the most common opener for stating rules, policies, or norms in English.

depth-054-058.prompt_zh: 别着急，慢慢来——这种事急不得。
depth-054-058.reference_answer: Take your time — these things can't be rushed.
grammar_point: Can't be + past participle for impossibility

hint_json.simple: 在安慰人别急。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 Take your time 表达「慢慢来」。后半句用 can't be + 过去分词表达「急不来」。
hint_json.complete: Take your _____ — these things can't be _____.

depth-054-058.learning_goal: Use 'take your time' and 'can't be rushed' to reassure someone.
depth-054-058.learning_rationale: 'Take your time' and 'can't be rushed' are fixed expressions that convey patience and understanding.

depth-054-059.prompt_zh: 能不能帮我把这份表格填一下？有几个地方我不太确定怎么填。
depth-054-059.reference_answer: Could you help me fill out this form? There are a few parts I'm not sure how to fill in.
grammar_point: Could you help me + base form
Be not sure how to + verb

hint_json.simple: 在请人帮忙填表，因为有些地方不会填。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 Could you help me + 动词原形做请求。后半句用 be not sure how to + 动词原形。
hint_json.complete: Could you help me _____ this form? There are a few parts I'm not sure how to _____.

depth-054-059.learning_goal: Ask for form-filling help and explain uncertainty about specific fields.
depth-054-059.learning_rationale: 'Fill out' vs 'fill in' — 'fill out' is for the whole form, 'fill in' is for individual fields.

depth-054-060.prompt_zh: 这张表填完之后请签上名字和日期，然后再交到前台。
depth-054-060.reference_answer: Once you've filled out this form, please sign and date it, then hand it in at reception.

hint_json.simple: 在说填完表格后的三个步骤。
hint_json.intermediate: 用 Once + 现在完成时表达「填完之后」。后面用祈使句序列说三个动作。
hint_json.complete: Once you've _____ this form, please sign and date it, then hand it _____ at reception.

depth-054-060.learning_goal: Use 'once + present perfect' to sequence post-completion steps.
depth-054-060.learning_rationale: 'Once you've + PP' is the standard pattern for 'after you finish doing X' in written instructions.
